FFT amplitude

Source: R/fft.R
fft_amplitude.Rd

Fast Fourier Transform (FFT): get amplitudes from coefficients

Usage

fft_amplitude(coefficients)

Arguments

coefficients

num. The Fourier coefficients.

Value

\(a_{n}\) array of amplitudes.

Examples


fft_rfft(temperatures = hobo$t_hobo[1:(24 * 5)]) |>
  fft_amplitude()
